MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING

This Memorandum of Understanding is between Harbor Arts Collective ("Collective") and Riverside Public Library ("Library").

1. Purpose. The parties will work together on a summer reading and arts program for children.

2. Roles. The Library will provide its community room on Saturday mornings. The Collective will provide two teaching artists and the art supplies.

3. Costs. Each party bears its own costs.

4. Term. This Memorandum runs from June 1, 2026 to August 31, 2026, and either party may end it on 14 days notice.
